an5.27:1.1: “Meditators, develop limitless composure, alert and mindful.
an5.27:1.2: When you develop limitless composure, alert and mindful, five knowledges arise for you personally.
an5.27:1.4: ‘This composure is blissful now, and results in bliss in the future.’ …
an5.27:1.5: ‘This composure is noble and not of the flesh.’ …
an5.27:1.6: ‘This composure is not cultivated by reprobates.’ …
an5.27:1.7: ‘This composure is peaceful and sublime and tranquil and unified, not held in place by forceful suppression.’ …
an5.27:1.8: ‘I mindfully enter into and emerge from this composure.’ …
an5.27:2.1: Develop limitless composure, alert and mindful.
an5.27:2.2: When you develop limitless composure, alert and mindful, these five knowledges arise for you personally.”
